edges.notes: Cilium is widely documented as a Kubernetes CNI and platform component.
Cilium's design centers on eBPF programs for datapath.
eBPF execution requires a capable Linux kernel.
Some Cilium features integrate Envoy where documented for L7 policy / ingress.
Overlapping service connectivity / mesh problem space; not identical architectures.
Linux nodes may still carry netfilter rules alongside eBPF datapaths during migration or for host policy; kube-proxy iptables modes differ from Cilium’s eBPF model.
